authority: PI, 2026-09-02, in response to observed collection throughput after launch
rule: this is an APPEND, not an edit. CCP_S2_SPEC.json, CCP_S2_SEED_ASSIGNMENT.json, and CCP_S2_STATE_MANIFEST.json (c366f317) are not modified in place. This record narrows the compute budget only; every other frozen design element listed below is unchanged.

OUTCOME_BLINDNESS_STATEMENT.claim: this amendment was decided and frozen WITHOUT inspecting any BASE/pi_A/pi_B outcome, win/loss, margin, advantage estimate, teacher-selection count, or tie rate from the 136 rows already collected under the original 10176-job plan.
OUTCOME_BLINDNESS_STATEMENT.basis_for_the_decision: observed wall-clock throughput only -- approximately 65s/job across 4 concurrent CUDA workers on the single available GPU (RTX 5070, 12GB), versus the frozen spec's idealized 43s/job (itself Phase 1's empirically measured rate). At the observed rate the original 10176-job plan projects to roughly 46 wall-clock hours; no additional compatible GPU/machine is available to this program, so Option A (distribute the frozen plan across more hardware) was ruled out on infrastructure grounds, not scientific grounds.
OUTCOME_BLINDNESS_STATEMENT.why_this_matters: CCP-S2's own routing rule already treats exact ties as zero-weight and its EVAL protocol was frozen before any measurement; this amendment preserves that discipline by being decided on throughput alone, prospectively, before the causal question is touched at all.

REDUCTION.derivation: a deterministic RANK-ORDER TRUNCATION of the already-frozen 128-state manifest (CCP_S2_STATE_MANIFEST.json, c366f317) -- not a new selection, not a new rollout, not a new hash domain. Every retained state was already selected under the original outcome-blind procedure; this amendment only shortens each stratum's already hash-ordered candidate list to a smaller prefix.
REDUCTION.halving_convention: each free_set's ORIGINAL per-pole total (agent0_only 19, agent1_only 24, both_free 21, summing to 64) is scaled by 32/64 and rounded to the nearest integer triple summing to 32 -- agent0_only 19*0.5=9.5, agent1_only 24*0.5=12 exactly, both_free 21*0.5=10.5 -- giving (10, 12, 10). Within a free_set whose new total is not evenly divisible by 3 phases, the remainder is assigned to the LATE phase, matching the original quota's own asymmetry (agent0_only was already 6/6/7, biased toward late). This convention is stated here, fixed, and applied identically to both poles -- it is not tuned per-pole or per-stratum.
REDUCTION.seed_formula_unchanged: r_j = H('CCP_S2_MEASURE', state_id, estimand, j) is not altered. This amendment only stops using j in {8,...,15}; j in {0,...,7} keep the exact values the frozen mapping always produced for them.

job_count.formula: 64 states -> 104 state-estimand pairs (22 one-free x1 + 10 both-free x3, per pole, x2 poles) -> x3 arms x M=8 = 2496

wall_clock_estimate.note: consistent with the PI's own ~11-12h estimate for this reduced design at 4 workers

ALREADY_COMPLETED_ROWS_RULE.rule: a row already written under the original 10176-job plan is RETAINED iff its (state_id, estimand, arm, j) job_id is a member of the amended 2496-job set. Every other already-written row is ARCHIVED_UNUSED: preserved on disk exactly where it was written (ccp_s2_rows/worker_*.jsonl), never deleted, never edited, and never used in bank construction, the advantage estimator, routing, or any descriptive statistic of this program.
ALREADY_COMPLETED_ROWS_RULE.mechanism: the resumed collector (experiments/ccp_s2_collect_amended.py) builds its job list exclusively from the amended 64-state/M=8 plan. Its own resume logic (done_ids read from each worker's existing jsonl) then naturally recognises retained rows as already-done and skips them; archived-unused rows sharing the same file simply match no job_id in the amended plan and are inert.
ALREADY_COMPLETED_ROWS_RULE.reconciliation_record_required: CCP_S2_AMENDMENT_RECONCILIATION.json, frozen BEFORE collection resumes, listing the exact retained and archived-unused counts and job_id sets -- computed once, not re-derived ad hoc later.

UNCHANGED: three-arm design: R_0 (incumbent baseline) / pi_A / pi_B
incumbent-relative advantage estimator: A_hat(x) = mean_j(R_arm^j - R_0^j)
all three topology types: agent0_only, agent1_only, both_free
early/mid/late stratification axis itself (only the per-cell quota shrinks)
warm-start treatment vs matched PPO-only control design
fresh 64-seed sealed EVAL block (11701001..11701064), untouched by any of this

the collector implementation itself (setup_env/replay_prefix/run/continuation_seed in experiments/ccp_s2_collect.py) -- reused verbatim, not reimplemented, so its COLLECTOR_VERIFIED gate (CCP_S2_COLLECTOR_SMOKE.json) remains valid evidence about the actual measurement code

ACKNOWLEDGED_COST.coarser_causal_estimates: 1/8 = 0.125 granularity per arm's mean advantage, versus the original 1/16 = 0.0625
ACKNOWLEDGED_COST.higher_expected_exact_tie_rate: M=8 gives fewer distinct achievable (n+ - n-)/M values, so exact positive ties between A_hat_A and A_hat_B are more likely under the routing rule's existing zero-weight-on-tie clause. Per CCP_S2_SPEC.json's already-frozen ROUTING_RULE, this must be reported descriptively once the amended bank exists, not assumed away.
ACKNOWLEDGED_COST.PI_framing: a prospectively amended, interpretable ~11h experiment over a pristine but impractical ~46h one -- decided on throughput alone, before any causal result was opened.

sequence: this amendment -> derive CCP_S2_STATE_MANIFEST_AMENDMENT.json (rank-truncation, no new rollout) -> derive+freeze the amended job plan -> freeze the retained/archived reconciliation -> resume the 4 workers under the amended plan only.
